title: AUTHORITY IN PRAYER
MIDNIGHT DECREES
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: deep starry night sky over mountains
glowing lantern on old wooden table
distant lighthouse beam over dark ocean
silhouette of church steeple against moon
open vintage bible in dim candle light

scenes.a: If the weight of that recurring worry keeps you pacing in the dark, listen here.
Your prayers hold a weight that shifts the spiritual atmosphere of your entire home today.
Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
Lord, I lift up the one listening, asking that you grant them clarity and strength.
Let them step into the authority given, closing doors to fear and opening heavens.
May your spirit rest now in the peace of knowing you are heard tonight. Amen.
